title: Free To Choose 1980 - Vol. 01 The Power of the Market - Full Video
summary: The first episode of Milton Friedman's 1980 Free To Choose series, on how markets and voluntary exchange organize economic activity and the price system. It includes visits to Hong Kong, the U.S. and Scotland and a panel discussion with critics.
why: Commenters say it made market economics click for them and find it an interesting documentary relevant to welfare and UBI debates.
